newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HIGHBURY, OLD TRAFFORD TO STAGE F.A. CUP SEMIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HIGHBURY, OLD TRAFFORD TO STAGE F.A. CUP SEMIS.

text.p: Arsenal's Highbury stadium and Manchester United's Old Trafford will be the venues for this season's F.A. Cup semifinals, the English F.A. said on Monday.
Highbury will host the all-London tie between Chelsea and Wimbledon at 1100 GMT on April 13. Middlesbrough will face second division Chesterfield at Old Trafford three hours later.
If replays are required, the Middlesbrough-Chesterfield tie will be staged at Hillsborough, Sheffield on April 22. Chelsea and Wimbledon would return to Highbury the same night.
